text_block_list.text: The day of the Diamond Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: Hmm, you seem unusually fired up today...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I set my goals at the start of the 
year, so I'm all fired up to give it my 
all this year~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm fully fired up! Both my mind and body 
are totally buff!

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I see...! I can really feel your passion 
for victory! I'll make sure to deliver it 
to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's Matikanetannhauser! Lucky!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I became a fan of yours at the Kikuka Sho! 
I'm really looking forward to your race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah!? Th-thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Given your strong performances in the 
Classic Year, I've heard many voices eager 
to see you excel.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wha, really!?

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: Yes... truth be told, I am one of them.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Um... do you happen to remember the day 
you interviewed me at Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...An interview...? Ah, could it be right 
after the Satsuki Sho?!

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Back then, Tannhauser-san's words 
really felt like they saved me, in a way.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? S-S-Saved...?

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Um... Pardon me for bringing up personal 
matters, but truth be told, I've been 
feeling somewhat stuck with my work...

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I'm terrible at interviewing and my 
articles are mediocre... I was just 
starting to feel the limits of my own 
abilities...

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Still... seeing Tannhauser-san assert that 
she's 'nothing special'—

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Watching her strive for 'victory' despite 
feeling that way really struck a chord 
with me."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No, no, that can't be...!

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"I had somewhat given up on myself for 
being ordinary, so seeing her keep 
fighting despite calling herself 'average' 
looked so dazzling to me..."

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
It gave me hope, too... It felt like a 
gentle push encouraging me to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! I'm sorry, bringing this up out of 
nowhere!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, not in the slightest! In fact, 
I'm delighted!

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Good luck in your race! I'll be rooting 
for you from the shadows! ...Farewell for 
now!

The reporter with round glasses bowed, 
then entered the racecourse carrying a 
heavy-looking bag.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...That was such lovely news.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Mun, today I'm really... going to do my 
best! Let's go, Trainer!

With an unexpected push from those around 
her, the Diamond Stakes finally got 
underway.
